subject: Mental Models
title: Leverage Points
description: A quick win: understand Leverage Points.

hook.text: Archimedes said give me a lever long enough and I can move the earth. Systems have leverage points too—.

buildup.text: Donella Meadows listed 12 places to intervene in a system.

discovery.text: The highest leverage point is changing the paradigm: the mindset a system operates under.

twist.text: People instinctively push on the weakest leverage points like adjusting parameters because they are easiest.

climax.text: Before acting, ask: am I pushing on a shallow lever or a deep one? The deeper the intervention.

punchline.text: Small nudge, big change. But only at the right point.

quiz.question: What is the most powerful leverage point according to Meadows?
options: Changing the paradigm or mindset the system operates under
